## Rubric

| Signal    | Pass                                           |
| --------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| Scope     | One increment, no unrelated cleanup            |
| Behavior  | Observable outcome is met                      |
| Tests     | Focused command is green                       |
| Contracts | No invented Prisma/Auth0/GitHub/OpenAPI fields |
| Learning  | PR reflection completed                        |

Eligibility is decided by reviewers and required checks, not by AI.
